fullContent:
Gokshuradi Kwath 
 Reference: Sahasrayogam, Kashaya Prakarana, 48.2 
 Gokshuradi Kwath is a herbal decoction preparation, also known by the other names like Gokshuradi Kashaya and Gokshuradi Kadha. It is used to cure the inflammatory conditions. It calms Vata, Pitta and Kapha. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Gokshura – Tribulus terrestris 
 Wet Ginger – Zingiber officinalis 
 Punarnava – Boerrhavia diffusa 
 Harad – Terminalia chebula 
 Daru – Cedrus deodara 
 Dry ginger – Zingiber officinale 
 Garlic – Allium sativum 
 Ikshuraka – Asteracantha longifiolia 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Gokshuradi Kwath is prepared by boiling the herbal powder of above mentioned herbs in 8 parts of water. Boiling is done until the water is reduced to quarter part. 
 Dosage 
 Take 5 – 10 ml, before food, or on empty stomach, once or twice a day or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Indication 
 It is used in the treatment of inflammation, edema and benign prostate hypertrophy. 
 Side Effects 
 
 Take this medicine only under medical supervision. 
 It has a mild diuretic action. 
 Special care is needed while administering this medicine to people who are on medication for high BP. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
